English voice: af_heart
Spanish voice: ef_dora

Spanish voices: ef_dora, em_alex, em_santa
Set one with /speak-voice [en|es] <name>, or /speak-voice [en|es] default.

commands.name: speak-rate
commands.description: Set the reading speed in words per minute (80-500)

commands.name: speak-install
commands.description: Install Kokoro, the natural local voices (needs uv); --repair reinstalls
commands.output: uv is needed to install Kokoro. Install it with `brew install uv` or `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`, then run /speak-install again.

commands.name: speak-engine
commands.description: Read aloud with Kokoro (local neural voices) or macOS say; alone, show the engine
commands.output:
Engine: kokoro (default).
Kokoro: not installed; run /speak-install. Reading falls back to say.
